title: Fully Funded Scholarships in Canada 2027
description: Apply to fully funded Canadian scholarships covering tuition, a stipend, travel, and insurance for bachelor's, master's, or PhD study. Open to international students at all degree levels.
descriptionDetailed: Canadian government bodies, provincial programs, and top universities such as the University of Toronto, University of British Columbia, and McGill fund scholarships that cover the full cost of international study. Benefits typically include full tuition, a monthly living stipend, travel support, and health insurance. A good option if you want affordable, research-focused study in Canada across undergraduate, master's, and PhD programs.

prize.description: Fully funded scholarships typically cover full tuition fees, a monthly stipend, travel expenses, and health insurance; some also add settlement allowances and housing support. Amounts vary by scholarship and institution.

audience.eligibilityDetail: Applicants need relevant prior qualifications (secondary school, bachelor's, or master's), admission to a Canadian program, and English or French proficiency; competitive awards also value leadership and extracurricular involvement. Requirements vary by scholarship and institution.
